Through a series of glowing geometric forms—tori and spheres that orbit and rotate in three-dimensional space—alongside ethereal sheets that form and dissipate, the scene portrays an ever-shifting cosmic landscape. The emerald and cyan hues shift across the canvas as forms grow, merge, and decay, suggesting the continuous process of creation and dissolution in the vastness of interstellar space.
